facts.fact: The IDEA progress report for January-June 2026 says resilient telecom links with the disaster recovery site in Blantyre were commissioned for the Government national data centre in Lilongwe, and a redundancy link between the Lilongwe and Blantyre data centres was completed; main site in Lilongwe, backup in Blantyre. The date of the DR site entering service is not stated; the report's period is used.
facts.system: Government national data centre disaster recovery site, Blantyre
